name: Heavyweight Boxy Tee
description: Crafted from 300GSM organic cotton. A structured drape designed for the architecture of the body. Features dropped shoulders and a minimalist silhouette.

reviews.text: Phigai's quality is unmatched. The drape on this tee is perfect for my Gen-Z wardrobe.
Incredibly soft yet holds its shape. A true staple.

name: Archival Raw Denim
description: 14oz Selvedge denim sourced from Okayama. Rigid construction that ages with the wearer. Relaxed fit through the leg.

reviews.text: Best raw denim I've owned. The indigo depth is beautiful.
The silhouette is archival perfection. Worth every rupee.

reviews.text: Clean, minimal, and fits perfectly. My daily go-to.
